## أتمتة المتصفح — Browser automation & web apps testing

#### AWEB-02 · جلب ثابت أولا ثم احتياط المتصفح · Static-first scrape with headless-browser fallback · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** جلب الصفحة ثابتا أولا ثم التصعيد لمتصفح بلا واجهة فقط عند صفحات JS أو الحماية. — Fetch statically first and escalate to headless Chrome only when the page is a JS shell or WAF-blocked.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Static fetch returns empty or stub content; SPA, infinite scroll, interstitials.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Try static fetch. 2) Check for near-empty body, noscript warnings, WAF vendor fingerprints. 3) Re-fetch with browser mode auto|always|never (always for known SPAs, never in hot loops or sandboxes). 4) Optionally attach external CDP endpoint. 5) Inspect content and warnings fields before trusting result. 6) Script clicks/scroll/wait before extraction when interaction is needed. **أرقام / params:** browser-mode, endpoint
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`chromium`](../requirements.md#req-chromium)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2101-crawlberg/7459-headless-fallback` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2101-crawlberg/7456-automating-the-browser`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): crawlberg/headless-fallback (#7459); crawlberg/automating-the-browser (#7456) · theme browser-automation · 4 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/2101-crawlberg/7459-headless-fallback, skills/2101-crawlberg/7456-automating-the-browser

## هندسة النماذج اللغوية — LLM & AI engineering

#### AWEB-05 · قرار الضبط الدقيق واختيار الطريقة · Fine-tune or not: method router · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تقرير هل نضبط النموذج وتوجيه إلى الطريقة المناسبة حسب البيانات وحجم النص. — Decide whether to fine-tune and route to SFT, DPO, GRPO or CPT by data type and text volume.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Starting any fine-tuning effort or choosing RAG vs training.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Volatile facts: RAG. 2) Unsettled behavior: prompting. 3) Domain text <10MB RAG; 10-500MB RAG+FT; 0.5-10GB CPT then SFT; >10GB CPT. 4) Demonstrations: SFT; preference pairs: DPO/ORPO/KTO; verifiable reward: GRPO/RLVR. 5) CPT LR about 10% of pretraining LR. 6) No eval harness: build it first. Then export merged/quantized. **أرقام / params:** domain text volume
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`pip:chromadb`](../requirements.md#req-pip-chromadb)

## القطاعات المنظّمة — Regulated industries & domain expertise

#### AWEB-06 · بوابة نقاط النهاية وحجم العينة للدراسات · Clinical study endpoint and sample-size gate · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تقييم نقاط النهاية وتقدير حجم العينة وإصدار قرار جاهزية للدراسة. — Score endpoints, estimate two-arm sample size and score study feasibility into a go/no-go packet.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Designing a prospective study before submission.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Fill protocol synopsis template. 2) endpoint_selector: 5 weighted dimensions, classify primary/key-secondary/exploratory, flag surrogates. 3) sample_size_estimator for means (Cohen d), proportions, survival (Schoenfeld) with sourced effect size. 4) phase_gate_scorer 0-100 giving GO / GO-WITH-CONDITIONS / REDESIGN / NO-GO plus owners. 5) Route to biostatistician and medical monitor; output is advisory. **أرقام / params:** design, effect size, alpha, power
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/217-research-ops-skills/690-clinical-research`

## إدارة المعرفة — Notes, knowledge bases & personal memory

#### AWEB-10 · قواعد بيانات الملاحظات بملفات Obsidian Bases · Database views over notes with Obsidian Bases · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يبني ملف .base بصيغة YAML يعرض الملاحظات كجدول أو بطاقات أو قائمة بفلاتر وصيغ وملخصات. — Builds a YAML .base file that shows notes as table, cards or list views with filters, formulas and summaries.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** متتبع مهام أو قائمة قراءة أو فهرس يوميات داخل Obsidian / a task tracker, reading list or daily-notes index inside an Obsidian vault
- **كيف / how:** 1) Scope with global filters (and/or/not over file.hasTag, file.inFolder, properties). 2) Define computed columns under formulas and reference them as formula.NAME. 3) Add one or more views with order, groupBy, per-view filters and summaries (Average, Sum, Median, Earliest...). 4) Date differences are Durations: read .days before rounding. 5) Quote any string with : { } [ ] # etc.; single-quote formulas that contain double quotes. 6) Validate the YAML and that every formula.X is defined, then open it in Obsidian; embed with ![[Name.base#View]]. **أرقام / params:** vault folder, tags
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1247-obsidian-bases/2927-obsidian-bases`

#### AWEB-11 · التعرّف بدل التذكّر في المنتقيات والقوائم · Recognition over recall in pickers and menus · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصمم المدخلات بحيث يرى المستخدم الخيارات ويتعرّف عليها بدل أن يتذكرها ويكتبها. — Designs inputs so the user sees and recognises options instead of recalling and typing them.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** منتقي تاريخ أو منطقة زمنية، لوحة أوامر، حقل بحث، قائمة إعدادات / pickers, command palettes, autocomplete, settings, navigation
- **كيف / how:** 1) For each input ask: are the valid options shown, or must the user remember them? 2) Large known sets: a combobox (type a few letters, recognise from filtered matches) with recents first. 3) Surface recents and frequently used items in pickers and navigation. 4) Hook fields to autocomplete and show example values instead of 'Enter value'. 5) Keep recall paths (shortcuts, CLI) for experts alongside, and keep recall where it is the point (passwords, free text). 6) Test discoverability: can a newcomer find the feature without knowing its name?
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3771-recognition-over-recall`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas frontier mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): universal-design-principles/recognition-over-recall (#3771) · theme knowledge-management · SKILL.md read up to its first 12,000 characters as inert text (rest not read): skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3771-recognition-over-recall
